owner_cleanup_revision: Capture pidfd identities for every directly started worker before unmasking owner alarm. After any frozen-dispatch exception, independently confirm/reap all captured children under alarm masking and deferred stop signals; do not release the lease when confirmation fails. No unrelated PID lookup or /proc access.
required_reviewer_scope: Validate new admission/source/archive binding, exact relocation/no-original-writes, whole8 membership, private worker limits before scientific imports, SIGALRM ownership-capture mask and confirmed drain. No real sampling in tests.

root_shared_memory_admission.formula: own (workers+1)*RLIMIT_AS + root-bound external planning reservations <=8GiB; external estimates explicitly need not be hard limits

sampling_envelope.owner_CPU_semantics: Observed cooperative process-CPU budget checked by hash/guard operations and metadata watchdog; not an inherited low RLIMIT_CPU that would prevent children installing the6h hard cap.
sampling_envelope.resource_semantics: RLIMIT_AS is an independently enforced per-process virtual-address cap. The sum is not a claim of measured RSS. Owner and known live workers report their own positive peak RSS; missing/stale/invalid live-worker evidence stops admission and draining is requested. The aggregate3GiB RSS screen remains an observed planning rule, not a kernel quota.

scope: New scheduling-only owner around frozen one_seed; all scientific parameters/prefixes/seed order/analysis remain from the proposal. This policy supplements the historical design before implementation/adoption. Resource revision only: this environment does not expose owned /proc stat. Each process has an enforced1GiB RLIMIT_AS; positive own getrusage reports replace unobservable /proc RSS. No physics or scientific gate changes.

storage_revision.watchdog_action: Signal only this owner to stop admissions and bounded-drain owned children before reaching the reserved floor. It reads filesystem free bytes and only owned-worker RSS, never another project or process.
